About Us - Your Partner in Higher Education Journey

We are a leading company in educational consulting, helping students achieve their academic dreams in China and Turkey.

Contact Us Our Services

Our Vision and Mission

Our Vision

To be the bridge that connects Arab students with the best universities in China and Turkey, and to contribute to building an educated and qualified generation to lead the future.

Our Mission

We are committed to providing distinguished and comprehensive educational consulting services that help students choose the appropriate educational destination and obtain the best academic opportunities and scholarships.

Our Success Story

Our journey began with a firm belief that education is the key to progress and success. Since our establishment, we have helped thousands of students obtain university admissions and scholarships at the best Chinese and Turkish universities.

We started as a small team of passionate educators and have grown into a trusted organization with offices in multiple countries. Our dedication to student success has remained unchanged throughout our growth.

We are proud to be trusted partners for students and parents in the higher education journey. Our alumni network now spans across continents, with graduates excelling in various fields.

The Values We Believe In

Transparency

We provide clear and honest information about all available options. No hidden fees or misleading promises.

Excellence

We always strive to provide the best services and achieve the highest quality standards in everything we do.

Commitment

We are committed to helping our students from the beginning of the journey until they achieve their goals.

Innovation

We continuously develop our services to keep pace with developments in higher education and student needs.

Our Specialized Team

Our team includes a group of educational consultants with extensive experience in international education. Each member of our team specializes in a specific field and has deep knowledge of the educational systems in China and Turkey.

Ahmed Hassan

Academic Consultant

Specializing in Chinese universities with 10 years of experience helping students navigate the application process.

Ahmed Hassan

Academic Consultant

Specializing in Chinese universities, 10 years of experience.

Fatima Al-Mansoori

Scholarship Consultant

Expert in Chinese government scholarships with a proven track record of securing funding for students.

Fatima Al-Mansoori

Scholarship Consultant

Experienced in Chinese government scholarships.

Mehmet Yılmaz

Turkish Universities Consultant

Specialist in Turkish private universities with extensive knowledge of admission requirements and scholarship opportunities.

Mehmet Yılmaz

Turkish Universities Consultant

Experienced in private universities in Turkey.

Our Achievements in Numbers

5000+

Students helped with university admissions

2000+

Scholarships obtained by our students

5+

Years of educational consulting experience

95%

Success rate in admissions and scholarships

Our Strategic Partnerships

We collaborate with many prestigious universities in China and Turkey, ensuring our students get the best educational opportunities.

Chinese Universities

  • Peking University
  • Tsinghua University
  • Fudan University
  • Zhejiang University
  • Shanghai Jiao Tong University

Turkish Universities

  • Bahçeşehir University
  • Istanbul Aydın University
  • Istanbul Technical University
  • Ankara University
  • Bilkent University

Our Commitment to You

We believe that every student deserves the best possible education. Our commitment extends beyond just securing admission - we're with you every step of the way.

Continuous Support

From the first moment of contact until graduation and beyond, we provide ongoing guidance and assistance.

Free Consultation

We provide free, no-obligation consultations to all students to help them understand their options.

Complete Transparency

No hidden fees or surprises. We're upfront about all costs and requirements from day one.

Regular Follow-up

We follow up on our students' progress and provide support when needed, even after they've started their studies.

What Our Students Say?

Mohammed Al-Farsi

Peking University, Computer Science

"Thanks to EduConnect team, I was able to get a full scholarship at Peking University. The service was excellent and the support was continuous throughout my application process. They even helped me with visa procedures and accommodation arrangements."

Aisha Al-Hamadi

Istanbul Aydın University, Business

"They helped me get a 70% discount at a prestigious Turkish university. I recommend every student to deal with them. Their knowledge of the Turkish education system was impressive, and they guided me through every document requirement."

Contact Us Today

Ready to start your educational journey? Contact us for a free consultation and let us help you find the perfect university program.
